arguments.command:
cd $GITHUB_WORKSPACE && git checkout -q -b release-0.36.0 && npm version 0.36.0 --no-git-tag-version >/dev/null && sed -i 's#git:github.com/cv/pit@v0.35.1#git:github.com/cv/pit@v0.36.0#' README.md && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='CHANGELOG.md'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("## [Unreleased]

","## [Unreleased]

## [0.36.0] - 2026-11-12

",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -rn "0\.35\.1" README.md docs | head; git diff --stat; sed -n 1,12p CHANGELOG.md
